text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Cherry blossoms, cherry blossoms! Blossoms all around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's springtime, and the students are heading to school through a path of cherry blossom trees.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, cherry blossoms! That's my flower… my most favorite one of all!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: They're so elegant. I can't believe spring has come again so soon.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How fortuitous that we may see the cherry blossoms on our way to school.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's everybody usually get up to durin' the blossom season?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What do we usually do? Well, I spend a lot of time outside enjoying tea. Occasionally, a little petal will flutter into my cup.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My routine is this—hiyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's a thrusting technique to hit the petals with the tip of your fist while preventing the wind pressure from blowing them away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just find myself looking up a lot of the time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I imagine the day they'll be in full bloom. It's not until then that they seem to truly be "cheery blossoms."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Full bloom… We are much like the buds of the cherry blossom tree. One day, we will unfurl into the most graceful of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: By the way, Inari One… How do you like to appreciate cherry blossoms?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… I don't much. Instead, I get my grub on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I-indeed. You care more for the picnic than the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What?! I make you feel sour or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please give me a bite!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh… Sure thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their pure and heartfelt words echo amidst the cherry blossoms.
